name: Acid–Base Titration
teachingNotes: Titration is a quantitative volumetric analysis technique. The color change indicates the endpoint; the theoretical equivalence point is where stoichiometric amounts of acid and base neutralize completely.

steps.prompt: Step 1: Set up the apparatus. Click or tap the Retort Stand & Clamp to secure the burette assembly.
steps.hint: Click on the Retort Stand or Clamp on the workbench to mount the glassware plumb and secure.
steps.completionText: Retort stand and clamp securely assembled. Burette is held vertically.

steps.prompt: Step 2: Fill the burette and clear the tip. Click the Burette or Stopcock to expel trapped air bubbles.
steps.hint: Trapped air bubbles below the stopcock introduce volume errors. Click the burette tip to tap it clear.
steps.completionText: Burette filled with titrant to initial mark; air bubble successfully expelled from tip.

steps.prompt: Step 3: Prepare analyte. Click the Dropper to add 2–3 drops of indicator into the conical flask.
steps.hint: Click the indicator dropper or the conical flask to dispense indicator drops into the acid solution.
steps.completionText: Indicator drops added to conical flask. Solution is clear and ready for titration.

steps.prompt: Step 4: Titrate! Hold the 'Open Stopcock (Titrate)' button or click the valve. Deliver titrant smoothly.
steps.hint: Hold or toggle the valve control to add titrant into the flask. Watch for brief flashes of pink color.
steps.completionText: Titrant delivered into the flask. Transient color flashes indicate the endpoint is approaching.

steps.prompt: Step 5: Dropwise approach to endpoint! Release the valve when a persistent pale pink color appears.
steps.hint: Stop adding titrant immediately when a faint permanent pale pink hue lasts at least 30 seconds. Do not overshoot!
steps.completionText: Perfect! Faint pale pink endpoint reached and maintained for 30 seconds.

steps.prompt: Step 6: Record observation. Click the Burette Meniscus to read the illustrative volume at eye level.
steps.hint: Align your eye horizontally with the bottom of the meniscus to avoid parallax error.
steps.completionText: Illustrative titre volume recorded: 22.40 mL ± 0.05 mL. Procedure completed successfully!

overshoot.message: Overshoot! Titrant was added past the endpoint, turning the solution dark magenta. In an analytical lab, excess titrant introduces a large positive error. Click Replay or Reset to try again.

bubble_ignored.message: Warning: Trapped air bubble in burette tip must be expelled before recording the initial volume.

wrong_apparatus.message: That apparatus is not required for the current procedure step. Follow the prompt above.
